022                
023//              data.getPerson().setPortraitSprite("graphics/portraits/portrait_ai2b.png");  
024//              data.getPerson().getName().setFirst("First");  
025//              data.getPerson().getName().setLast("Last");
026                
027

029                FleetMemberType type = FleetMemberType.SHIP;

031                        type = FleetMemberType.FIGHTER_WING; 
032                }
033                data.addStartingFleetMember(vid, type);
034                
035//              ShipVariantAPI variant = Global.getSettings().getVariant(vid);
036//              AddRemoveCommodity.addFleetMemberGainText(variant, dialog.getTextPanel());
037                
038                return true;
